name: io.github.AbdulMuhaiminKhan/github-mcp
title: GitHub (read-only)
description: Read-only GitHub repos, issues, PRs and commits, with tool descriptions tuned on a benchmark.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with read-only access (Metadata, Contents, Issues, Pull requests).

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_MCP_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: Tool descriptions to serve: v2 (default, optimized), v1 or v1b (benchmark baselines).
